Shiketsu Academy.text: The great hero academy of western Japan and U.A.'s closest rival: people speak of U.A. in the east and Shiketsu in the west. It trains high-school graduates over three years and is nearly as hard to enter. Its students wear dark formal uniforms with peaked caps, keep strict manners in public and train in rescue, teamwork and public conduct as hard as in combat; Shiketsu teaches that a hero's image is part of the job. Its first-years include Inasa Yoarashi, a huge, loud young man with a powerful wind Quirk who turned down a place at U.A. Outsiders see polished, reliable future heroes. The visible contradiction: an academy built on composure and modesty puts real energy into proving it is better than U.A.
